verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς λέγων
verses.transliteration: Kai palin ho Iēsous apokritheis eipen autois en parabolais legōn
verses.literal: [Once] again - Jesus spoke . . . to them in parables -

verses.original: ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν Ὡμοιώθη ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ ὅστις ἐποίησεν γάμους τῷ αὐτοῦ υἱῷ
verses.transliteration: hē basileia tōn ouranōn Hōmoiōthē anthrōpō basilei hostis epoiēsen gamous tō autou huiō
verses.literal: The kingdom of heaven is like vvv a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς δούλους καλέσαι τοὺς κεκλημένους εἰς τοὺς γάμους καὶ ἤθελον οὐκ ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen autou tous doulous kalesai tous keklēmenous eis tous gamous kai ēthelon ouk elthein
verses.literal: - He sent his - servants to call those he had invited to the banquet but they refused . . . to come

verses.original: Πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους λέγων Εἴπατε τοῖς κεκλημένοις Ἰδοὺ ἡτοίμακα μου τὸ ἄριστόν μου οἱ ταῦροί καὶ τὰ σιτιστὰ τεθυμένα καὶ πάντα ἕτοιμα δεῦτε εἰς τοὺς γάμους
verses.transliteration: Palin apesteilen allous doulous legōn Eipate tois keklēmenois Idou hētoimaka mou to ariston mou hoi tauroi kai ta sitista tethymena kai panta hetoima deute eis tous gamous
verses.literal: Again he sent other servants [and] said Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my - dinner My - oxen and - fattened cattle have been killed and everything [is] ready Come to the wedding banquet

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἀμελήσαντες ἀπῆλθον μὲν ὃς εἰς ἴδιον τὸν ἀγρόν δὲ ὃς ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐμπορίαν
verses.transliteration: de Hoi amelēsantes apēlthon men hos eis idion ton agron de hos epi autou tēn emporian
verses.literal: But - they paid no attention [and] went away - one to his - field - another to his - business

verses.original: δὲ οἱ λοιποὶ κρατήσαντες αὐτοῦ τοὺς δούλους ὕβρισαν καὶ ἀπέκτειναν
verses.transliteration: de hoi loipoi kratēsantes autou tous doulous hybrisan kai apekteinan
verses.literal: - The rest seized his - servants mistreated [them] and killed [them]

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ βασιλεὺς ὠργίσθη καὶ πέμψας αὐτοῦ τὰ στρατεύματα ἀπώλεσεν ἐκείνους τοὺς φονεῖς καὶ ἐνέπρησεν αὐτῶν τὴν πόλιν
verses.transliteration: de Ho basileus ōrgisthē kai pempsas autou ta strateumata apōlesen ekeinous tous phoneis kai eneprēsen autōn tēn polin
verses.literal: - The king was enraged and he sent his - troops to destroy those - murderers and burn their - city

verses.original: τότε λέγει τοῖς αὐτοῦ δούλοις μὲν Ὁ γάμος ἐστιν ἕτοιμός δὲ οἱ κεκλημένοι ἦσαν οὐκ ἄξιοι
verses.transliteration: tote legei tois autou doulois men Ho gamos estin hetoimos de hoi keklēmenoi ēsan ouk axioi
verses.literal: Then he said to his servants - The wedding banquet is ready but those I invited were not worthy

verses.original: πορεύεσθε οὖν ἐπὶ τὰς διεξόδους τῶν ὁδῶν καὶ καλέσατε εἰς τοὺς γάμους ὅσους ἐὰν εὕρητε
verses.transliteration: poreuesthe oun epi tas diexodous tōn hodōn kai kalesate eis tous gamous hosous ean heurēte
verses.literal: Go therefore to the crossroads . . . . . . and invite to the banquet as many as . . . you can find

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκεῖνοι οἱ δοῦλοι ἐξελθόντες εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς συνήγαγον πάντας οὓς εὗρον τε πονηρούς καὶ ἀγαθούς καὶ ὁ γάμος ἐπλήσθη ἀνακειμένων
verses.transliteration: Kai ekeinoi hoi douloi exelthontes eis tas hodous synēgagon pantas hous heuron te ponērous kai agathous kai ho gamos eplēsthē anakeimenōn
verses.literal: So - the servants went out into the streets [and] gathered everyone . . . they could find both evil and good and the wedding hall was filled with guests

verses.original: δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Εἰσελθὼν θεάσασθαι τοὺς ἀνακειμένους εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον ἐκεῖ οὐκ ἐνδεδυμένον γάμου ἔνδυμα
verses.transliteration: de ho basileus Eiselthōn theasasthai tous anakeimenous eiden anthrōpon ekei ouk endedymenon gamou endyma
verses.literal: But when the king came in to see the guests he spotted a man - [who was] not dressed in wedding clothes

verses.original: Ἑταῖρε καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ πῶς εἰσῆλθες ὧδε μὴ ἔχων γάμου ἔνδυμα δὲ Ὁ ἐφιμώθη
verses.transliteration: Hetaire kai legei autō pōs eisēlthes hōde mē echōn gamou endyma de Ho ephimōthē
verses.literal: Friend - he asked - how did you get in here vvv without wedding clothes But - [the man] was speechless

verses.original: Τότε ὁ βασιλεὺς εἶπεν τοῖς διακόνοις Δήσαντες αὐτοῦ χεῖρας καὶ πόδας ἐκβάλετε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ τὸ ἐξώτερον σκότος ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: Tote ho basileus eipen tois diakonois Dēsantes autou cheiras kai podas ekbalete auton eis to to exōteron skotos ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: Then the king told the servants Tie him hand and foot [and] throw him . . . into the - outer darkness [where] there will be - weeping and - gnashing of teeth

verses.original: γάρ Πολλοὶ εἰσιν κλητοὶ δὲ ὀλίγοι ἐκλεκτοί
verses.transliteration: gar Polloi eisin klētoi de oligoi eklektoi
verses.literal: For many are called but few [are] chosen

verses.original: Τότε οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πορευθέντες ἔλαβον συμβούλιον ὅπως παγιδεύσωσιν αὐτὸν ἐν λόγῳ
verses.transliteration: Tote hoi Pharisaioi poreuthentes elabon symboulion hopōs pagideusōsin auton en logō
verses.literal: Then the Pharisees went out [and] conspired . . . . . . to trap [Jesus] in His words

verses.original: καὶ ἀποστέλλουσιν αὐτῶν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτῷ μετὰ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν Διδάσκαλε λέγοντες οἴδαμεν ὅτι εἶ ἀληθὴς καὶ διδάσκεις τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ σοι μέλει περὶ οὐ οὐδενός γὰρ οὐ βλέπεις εἰς πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: kai apostellousin autōn tous mathētas autō meta tōn Hērōdianōn Didaskale legontes oidamen hoti ei alēthēs kai didaskeis tēn hodon tou Theou en alētheia kai soi melei peri ou oudenos gar ou blepeis eis prosōpon anthrōpōn
verses.literal: - They sent their - disciples to Him along with the Herodians Teacher they said we know that You are honest and [that] You teach the way - of God in accordance with the truth - You seek favor from vvv no one because vvv You pay no attention to external appearance . . .

verses.original: οὖν εἰπὸν ἡμῖν τί σοι δοκεῖ ἔξεστιν δοῦναι κῆνσον Καίσαρι ἢ οὔ
verses.transliteration: oun eipon hēmin ti soi dokei exestin dounai kēnson Kaisari ē ou
verses.literal: So tell us what You think Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γνοὺς αὐτῶν τὴν πονηρίαν εἶπεν ὑποκριταί Τί πειράζετε με
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Gnous autōn tēn ponērian eipen hypokritai Ti peirazete me
verses.literal: But - Jesus knew their - evil intent [and] said You hypocrites why are you testing Me

verses.original: ἐπιδείξατέ μοι τὸ νόμισμα τοῦ κήνσου δὲ Οἱ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δηνάριον
verses.transliteration: epideixate moi to nomisma tou kēnsou de Hoi prosēnenkan autō dēnarion
verses.literal: Show Me the coin used for the tax And - they brought Him a denarius

verses.original: Τίνος ἡ εἰκὼν αὕτη Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς καὶ ἡ ἐπιγραφή
verses.transliteration: Tinos hē eikōn hautē Kai legei autois kai hē epigraphē
verses.literal: Whose - image [is] this - He asked . . . and whose inscription

verses.original: Καίσαρος Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οὖν Τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἀπόδοτε Καίσαρι τὰ Καίσαρος καὶ τῷ Θεῷ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kaisaros Legousin autō oun Tote legei autois Apodote Kaisari ta Kaisaros kai tō Theō ta tou Theou
verses.literal: Caesar’s they answered . . . So - [Jesus] told them Give to Caesar what [is] Caesar’s and - to God what [is] - God’s

verses.original: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἀπῆλθαν
verses.transliteration: Kai akousantes ethaumasan kai aphentes auton apēlthan
verses.literal: And when they heard [this] they were amazed So they left Him [and] went away

verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ Σαδδουκαῖοι λέγοντες εἶναι μὴ ἀνάστασιν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: En ekeinē tē hēmera Saddoukaioi legontes einai mē anastasin prosēlthon autō kai epērōtēsan auton
verses.literal: - That [same] day [the] Sadducees who say there is no resurrection came to [Jesus] and questioned Him

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε λέγοντες Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν Ἐάν τις ἀποθάνῃ μὴ ἔχων τέκνα αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἐπιγαμβρεύσει αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἀναστήσει σπέρμα τῷ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφῷ
verses.transliteration: Didaskale legontes Mōusēs eipen Ean tis apothanē mē echōn tekna autou ho adelphos epigambreusei autou tēn gynaika kai anastēsei sperma tō autou adelphō
verses.literal: Teacher they said Moses declared that if a man dies without having children his - brother is to marry - the widow and raise up offspring for - [him]

verses.original: δὲ ἦσαν ἑπτὰ ἀδελφοί παρ’ ἡμῖν καὶ ὁ πρῶτος γήμας καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν μὴ ἔχων σπέρμα ἀφῆκεν αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα τῷ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφῷ
verses.transliteration: de ēsan hepta adelphoi par’ hēmin kai ho prōtos gēmas kai eteleutēsen mē echōn sperma aphēken autou tēn gynaika tō autou adelphō
verses.literal: Now there were seven brothers among us - The first [one] married and died without having children [So] he left his - wife to his brother

verses.original: ὁμοίως καὶ ὁ δεύτερος καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἕως τῶν ἑπτά
verses.transliteration: homoiōs kai ho deuteros kai ho tritos heōs tōn hepta
verses.literal: The same thing happened to . . . the second and - third [brothers] down to the seventh

verses.original: δὲ ὕστερον πάντων ἡ γυνή ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: de hysteron pantōn hē gynē apethanen
verses.literal: And last of all the woman died

verses.original: ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει οὖν τίνος γυνή ἔσται τῶν ἑπτὰ γὰρ πάντες ἔσχον αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: en tē anastasei oun tinos gynē estai tōn hepta gar pantes eschon autēn
verses.literal: In the resurrection then whose wife will she be of the seven For all of them were married to her

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πλανᾶσθε μὴ εἰδότες τὰς γραφὰς μηδὲ τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Apokritheis eipen autois Planasthe mē eidotes tas graphas mēde tēn dynamin tou Theou
verses.literal: - - Jesus answered - - You are mistaken [because] vvv you do not know the Scriptures or the power - of God

verses.original: γὰρ ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται ἀλλ’ εἰσιν ὡς ἄγγελοι ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ
verses.transliteration: gar en tē anastasei oute gamousin oute gamizontai all’ eisin hōs angeloi en tō ouranō
verses.literal: - In the resurrection vvv [people] will neither marry nor be given in marriage Instead they will be like [the] angels in - heaven

verses.original: δὲ περὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τὸ ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ῥηθὲν ὑμῖν λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: de peri tēs anastaseōs tōn nekrōn ouk anegnōte to hypo tou Theou rhēthen hymin legontos
verses.literal: But concerning the resurrection of the dead vvv have you not read what - - God said to you -

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσαὰκ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς Ἰακώβ ἔστιν οὐκ ὁ Θεὸς νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi ho Theos Abraam kai ho Theos Isaak kai ho Theos Iakōb estin ouk ho Theos nekrōn alla zōntōn
verses.literal: I am the God of Abraham - the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob He is not the God of [the] dead but of [the] living

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἀκούσαντες ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi ochloi akousantes exeplēssonto epi autou tē didachē
verses.literal: When the crowds heard [this] they were astonished at His - teaching

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἐφίμωσεν τοὺς Σαδδουκαίους συνήχθησαν αὐτό τὸ ἐπὶ
verses.transliteration: de Hoi Pharisaioi akousantes hoti ephimōsen tous Saddoukaious synēchthēsan auto to epi
verses.literal: And [when] the Pharisees heard that [Jesus] had silenced the Sadducees they themselves gathered . . . . . . together

verses.original: καὶ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν νομικὸς πειράζων αὐτόν ἐπηρώτησεν
verses.transliteration: kai heis ex autōn nomikos peirazōn auton epērōtēsen
verses.literal: - One of them an expert in the law tested Him with a question

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε ποία ἐντολὴ μεγάλη ἐν τῷ νόμῳ
verses.transliteration: Didaskale poia entolē megalē en tō nomō
verses.literal: Teacher which commandment [is the] greatest in the Law

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἔφη αὐτῷ Ἀγαπήσεις κύριον σου τὸν Θεόν ἐν ὅλῃ σου τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ σου τῇ ψυχῇ καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ σου τῇ διανοίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de Ho ephē autō Agapēseis kyrion sou ton Theon en holē sou tē kardia kai en holē sou tē psychē kai en holē sou tē dianoia
verses.literal: - - [Jesus] declared - Love [the] Lord your - God with all your - heart and with all your - soul and with all your - mind

verses.original: αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ πρώτη καὶ μεγάλη ἐντολή
verses.transliteration: hautē estin hē prōtē kai megalē entolē
verses.literal: This is the first and greatest commandment

verses.original: δὲ δευτέρα ὁμοία αὐτῇ Ἀγαπήσεις σου τὸν πλησίον ὡς σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: de deutera homoia autē Agapēseis sou ton plēsion hōs seauton
verses.literal: And [the] second [is] like it Love your - neighbor as yourself

verses.original: ὅλος ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται κρέμαται ἐν ταύταις δυσὶν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς
verses.transliteration: holos ho nomos kai hoi prophētai krematai en tautais dysin tais entolais
verses.literal: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two - commandments

verses.original: δὲ τῶν Φαρισαίων Συνηγμένων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς
verses.transliteration: de tōn Pharisaiōn Synēgmenōn ho Iēsous epērōtēsen autous
verses.literal: While the Pharisees were assembled - Jesus questioned them

verses.original: λέγων Τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ περὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ τίνος υἱός ἐστιν Τοῦ Δαυίδ Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: legōn Ti hymin dokei peri tou Christou tinos huios estin Tou Dauid Legousin autō
verses.literal: - What {do} you think about the Christ Whose son is He - David’s they answered -

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς Πῶς οὖν Δαυὶδ ἐν Πνεύματι καλεῖ αὐτὸν Κύριον λέγων
verses.transliteration: Legei autois Pōs oun Dauid en Pneumati kalei auton Kyrion legōn
verses.literal: [Jesus] said to them How then {does} David in [the] Spirit call Him Lord [For] he says

verses.original: Κύριος Εἶπεν τῷ μου Κυρίῳ Κάθου ἐκ μου δεξιῶν Ἕως ἂν θῶ σου τοὺς ἐχθρούς Ὑποκάτω σου τῶν ποδῶν
verses.transliteration: Kyrios Eipen tō mou Kyriō Kathou ek mou dexiōn Heōs an thō sou tous echthrous Hypokatō sou tōn podōn
verses.literal: The Lord said to my Lord Sit at My right hand until . . . I put Your - enemies under Your - feet

verses.original: οὖν Εἰ Δαυὶδ καλεῖ αὐτὸν Κύριον πῶς ἐστιν αὐτοῦ υἱὸς
verses.transliteration: oun Ei Dauid kalei auton Kyrion pōs estin autou huios
verses.literal: So if David calls Him Lord how can He be [David’s] son

verses.original: Καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἀποκριθῆναι αὐτῷ λόγον οὐδὲ ἀπ’ ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας τις ἐτόλμησέν ἐπερωτῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐκέτι
verses.transliteration: Kai oudeis edynato apokrithēnai autō logon oude ap’ ekeinēs tēs hēmeras tis etolmēsen eperōtēsai auton ouketi
verses.literal: - No one was able to answer - a word [and] from that - day [on] [no one] dared to question Him [any] further
